commands.name: Write-ConsoleLogEntry

commands.name: New-ConsoleAccordion

commands.name: New-ConsoleActivityList
commands.synopsis: Creates an activity list: the work in progress right now, one row per activity, with a spinner or a bar and the time it has taken.

commands.name: New-ConsoleBinding
commands.synopsis: Creates a display rebuilt from application state on the owning PowerShell input thread.

commands.name: New-ConsoleBreadcrumb
commands.synopsis: Creates a breadcrumb for Show-ConsoleApp: a path such as Settings › Network › Proxy, its own or that of an outline's current entry.

commands.name: New-ConsoleButton
commands.synopsis: Creates a named action button for Show-ConsoleApp.

commands.name: New-ConsoleCalendar
commands.synopsis: Creates a month or year calendar with dated operational outcomes.

commands.name: New-ConsoleCellMap
commands.synopsis: Creates a cell map: one status symbol per item of a run, with a legend of counts.

commands.name: New-ConsoleChart
commands.synopsis: Creates one numeric chart representation from records or samples.

commands.name: New-ConsoleChartView
commands.synopsis: Makes a line chart explorable inside Show-ConsoleApp.

commands.name: New-ConsoleCollapsible
commands.synopsis: Creates a collapsible section for Show-ConsoleApp.

commands.name: New-ConsoleColumns
commands.synopsis: Places console widgets side by side.

commands.name: New-ConsoleCommand
commands.synopsis: Defines an in-app action for buttons, palettes and grid rows.

commands.name: New-ConsoleDashboard
commands.synopsis: Defines a live console dashboard: a header with title and clock, the body and a footer.

commands.name: New-ConsoleDashboardFrame
commands.synopsis: Creates a dashboard frame: a summary with a title line, meters, a needs-attention list, sections, a legend and a footer.

commands.name: New-ConsoleDataGrid
commands.synopsis: Creates a named, embeddable data grid for Show-ConsoleApp.

commands.name: New-ConsoleDatePicker
commands.synopsis: Creates a persistent civil-date or inclusive range picker.

commands.name: New-ConsoleDiagram
commands.synopsis: Builds a diagram from a script block or connection rows.

commands.name: New-ConsoleDiagramGroup
commands.synopsis: Groups components and nested diagram groups.

commands.name: New-ConsoleDiagramLink
commands.synopsis: Connects two diagram components.

commands.name: New-ConsoleDiagramNode
commands.synopsis: Creates a diagram component.

commands.name: New-ConsoleDiagramStep
commands.synopsis: Creates a request, message, reply or failed interaction.

commands.name: New-ConsoleDiagramUseCase
commands.synopsis: Builds a playable sequence of diagram interactions.

commands.name: New-ConsoleDialog
commands.synopsis: Creates a typed modal form for the running app's dialog service.

commands.name: New-ConsoleField
commands.synopsis: Creates a form field for New-ConsoleForm.

commands.name: New-ConsoleFlow
commands.synopsis: Builds a native flow strip of nodes, labelled edges and one side branch.

commands.name: New-ConsoleForm
commands.synopsis: Creates a form or wizard from fields (New-ConsoleField) for Read-ConsoleForm or a menu item.

commands.name: New-ConsoleImage
commands.synopsis: Creates an image to place inside panels, columns and dashboards.

commands.name: New-ConsoleKeyValue
commands.synopsis: Creates an aligned key/value list from a hashtable, an object's properties or Key/Value records pairs.

commands.name: New-ConsoleLanes
commands.synopsis: Creates a lanes widget: one row per worker, server or item of a parallel workload.

commands.name: New-ConsoleLayoutGrid
commands.synopsis: Lays console widgets out in an equal-width grid.

commands.name: New-ConsoleLogRegion
commands.synopsis: Creates a log region: the newest lines of a log, bottom-aligned.

commands.name: New-ConsoleLogo
commands.synopsis: Creates banner text drawn with a pixel font and a colour gradient.

commands.name: New-ConsoleMenu
commands.synopsis: Creates a menu from items (New-ConsoleMenuItem) for Show-ConsoleMenu.

commands.name: New-ConsoleMenuItem
commands.synopsis: Creates a menu item: an action, a submenu, a form, a selection, a page, a review, the presets list, a separator or the exit.

commands.name: New-ConsoleOutline
commands.synopsis: Creates an outline for Show-ConsoleApp: a list of headings to jump between, such as settings groups or the sections of a long page.

commands.name: New-ConsolePanel
commands.synopsis: Creates a bordered panel with a title around other console widgets.

commands.name: New-ConsoleProgress
commands.synopsis: Creates a progress bar or an indeterminate activity indicator.

commands.name: New-ConsoleRegion
commands.synopsis: Creates a named region whose content can be replaced while a dashboard runs.

commands.name: New-ConsoleRows
commands.synopsis: Stacks console widgets vertically.

commands.name: New-ConsoleRule
commands.synopsis: Creates a horizontal rule, optionally with a title.

commands.name: New-ConsoleScreen
commands.synopsis: Creates a screen for Show-ConsoleApp: its content, its breadcrumb title and the keys that work on it.

commands.name: New-ConsoleScrollView
commands.synopsis: Creates a clipped vertical viewport for a small widget tree inside an app.

commands.name: New-ConsoleSelect
commands.synopsis: Creates a named select input for Show-ConsoleApp.

commands.name: New-ConsoleSplitter
commands.synopsis: Creates two panes with a divider that the mouse and keyboard can move.

commands.name: New-ConsoleStack
commands.synopsis: Layers console widgets on top of each other in the same space.

commands.name: New-ConsoleStatusList
commands.synopsis: Creates a checklist of items with status markers.

commands.name: New-ConsoleSummaryBar
commands.synopsis: Creates a summary bar: one line with progress, done of total, the time left and result counters.

commands.name: New-ConsoleTable
commands.synopsis: Creates a console table from pipeline objects.

commands.name: New-ConsoleTabs
commands.synopsis: Creates retained tabs with keyboard and pointer navigation.

commands.name: New-ConsoleText
commands.synopsis: Creates rich text: multicolour words for table cells, calculated properties, titles, labels, log lines or output on its own.

commands.name: New-ConsoleTextInput
commands.synopsis: Creates a named single-line text input for Show-ConsoleApp.

commands.name: New-ConsoleToggle
commands.synopsis: Creates a named Boolean toggle for Show-ConsoleApp.

commands.name: New-ConsoleTree
commands.synopsis: Creates a console tree from nested Label/Children records calls, hierarchical objects or nested hashtables.

commands.name: New-ConsoleTreeSelect
commands.synopsis: Creates an embeddable, lazy object tree for Show-ConsoleApp.

commands.name: Start-ConsoleRun
commands.synopsis: Starts a bounded run dashboard for work scheduled by your script.

commands.name: Update-Console
commands.synopsis: Updates a live widget or a caller-managed run through one validated operation.

commands.name: Read-ConsoleConfirm
commands.synopsis: Asks a yes/no question and returns $true or $false.

commands.name: Read-ConsoleDate
commands.synopsis: Asks for one civil date or inclusive date range.

commands.name: Read-ConsoleForm
commands.synopsis: Shows a form or wizard and returns the answers.

commands.name: Read-ConsoleNumber
commands.synopsis: Asks for a number.

commands.name: Read-ConsolePath
commands.synopsis: Asks for a file or folder path, with completion.

commands.name: Read-ConsoleSelect
commands.synopsis: Asks the user to pick one of the choices and returns the chosen object.

commands.name: Read-ConsoleText
commands.synopsis: Asks for a line of text.

commands.name: Show-Console
commands.synopsis: Shows objects, text and widgets in a readable view that fits the terminal.

commands.name: Show-ConsoleApp
commands.synopsis: Runs native input controls and dependent displays in a console application.

commands.name: Show-ConsoleDemo
commands.synopsis: Runs an embedded ConsoleMonster gallery demo in the current PowerShell runspace.

commands.name: Show-ConsoleDiagram
commands.synopsis: Shows a diagram from connection rows, a Diagram widget or a ChartForgeX file, with use case playback.

commands.name: Show-ConsoleGrid
commands.synopsis: Shows pipeline objects in an interactive grid and returns the rows you choose.

commands.name: Show-ConsoleHelp
commands.synopsis: Shows a command's help: synopsis, highlighted syntax, a parameter table and highlighted examples.

commands.name: Show-ConsoleImage
commands.synopsis: Shows an image in the console, at the size you ask for in cells.

commands.name: Show-ConsoleMenu
commands.synopsis: Shows a menu until the user exits.

commands.name: Show-ConsoleObject
commands.synopsis: Explores an object's members with the keyboard.

commands.name: Show-ConsoleOverview
commands.synopsis: Shows a compact, read-only summary of the local host.

commands.name: Show-ConsolePresentation
commands.synopsis: Presents a scripted demo one command at a time in a real shell.

commands.name: Show-ConsoleReplay
commands.synopsis: Rewinds a recorded run: an in-terminal player with a timeline, markers, failures, warnings and log search.

commands.name: Show-ConsoleSettings
commands.synopsis: Chooses ConsoleMonster's settings in the terminal with a live preview.

commands.name: Show-ConsoleStatusLine
commands.synopsis: Shows one status line that updates in place, with an optional spinner, clock and elapsed time.

commands.name: Show-ConsoleTable
commands.synopsis: Shows objects as a table with fitted columns, readable values and optional grouping.

commands.name: Export-ConsoleFrame
commands.synopsis: Exports a widget, a rendered frame or a live-session snapshot to PNG, HTML, SVG, Markdown or text.

commands.name: Export-ConsoleRecording
commands.synopsis: Exports a terminal session or dashboard recording to slide images, animations, video, a player or asciicast.

commands.name: Export-ConsoleTheme
commands.synopsis: Exports the current ConsoleMonster theme as a starting file for a user or team.

commands.name: Invoke-ConsoleDashboard
commands.synopsis: Runs a console dashboard live while a script does the work.

commands.name: Invoke-ConsoleHeadless
commands.synopsis: Runs a script (usually an app) on a headless terminal with scripted input and returns the screens it drew.

commands.name: Invoke-ConsolePester
commands.synopsis: Runs Pester tests with a live ConsoleMonster dashboard and a summary table.

commands.name: Invoke-ConsoleRecording
commands.synopsis: Records a script, an app on a headless terminal, or an interactive child shell and saves the result.

commands.name: Invoke-ConsoleRun
commands.synopsis: Runs a script block for every input item, optionally in parallel, with a live view of the run.

commands.name: Add-ConsoleRecordingMarker
commands.synopsis: Adds a chapter or an export hold to a recorded terminal session.

commands.name: Assert-ConsoleOutput
commands.synopsis: Compares console output with a golden file (for Pester and other tests).

commands.name: Compare-ConsoleObject
commands.synopsis: Compares object sets or shows property drift across a baseline matrix.

commands.name: Compare-ConsoleText
commands.synopsis: Compares text or files with numbered lines, highlighted words and collapsed unchanged regions.

commands.name: Complete-ConsoleRun
commands.synopsis: Finishes a run dashboard and prints its full summary into scrollback.

commands.name: ConvertTo-ConsoleView
commands.synopsis: Drafts a reusable console view from sample objects.

commands.name: Disable-ConsoleFormatting
commands.synopsis: Turns off the ConsoleMonster default formatting (Enable-ConsoleFormatting), all of it or some features.

commands.name: Enable-ConsoleFormatting
commands.synopsis: Enables the everyday console views, native format commands and theme colours.

commands.name: Get-ConsoleCapability
commands.synopsis: Shows what ConsoleMonster detected about the current terminal.

commands.name: Get-ConsoleDemo
commands.synopsis: Lists gallery demos and returns their complete PowerShell source.

commands.name: Get-ConsoleFormatting
commands.synopsis: Shows the formatting features enabled in this runspace.

commands.name: Get-ConsoleSetting
commands.synopsis: Shows ConsoleMonster's settings: the value of each and where it came from.

commands.name: Register-ConsoleView
commands.synopsis: Registers how a type is shown by Enable-ConsoleFormatting.

commands.name: Reset-ConsoleSetting
commands.synopsis: Undoes Set-ConsoleSetting for this session, and with -Save removes the value from the settings file.

commands.name: Set-ConsoleFormValue
commands.synopsis: Sets field values of a form, whether or not it is shown.

commands.name: Set-ConsoleSetting
commands.synopsis: Changes a ConsoleMonster setting for this session, and with -Save for every session.

commands.name: Set-ConsoleTheme
commands.synopsis: Selects the theme used by every ConsoleMonster widget.

commands.name: Stop-ConsoleRecording
commands.synopsis: Stops recording from inside the recorded child shell.

commands.name: Unregister-ConsoleView
commands.synopsis: Removes registered ConsoleMonster views and value shapers.

commands.name: Use-ConsoleProgress
commands.synopsis: Runs a script and shows its Write-Progress calls as an inline progress area.

commands.name: Use-ConsoleTarget
commands.synopsis: Runs a script block with ConsoleMonster output going somewhere else: a file, a text writer, any target, or a string.

commands.name: Wait-ConsoleDashboard
commands.synopsis: Pauses dashboard work, or captures its next checkpoint during a recording.

commands.name: Watch-Console
commands.synopsis: Runs a script block again and again and shows its latest output as a live view.

commands.name: Watch-ConsoleLog
commands.synopsis: Follows a log file or a local Windows event log with a live, scrollable log view.
